policy: Preserve source population totals. Resolve residents independently from the state religion and primary cultures. Explicit V3-granularity merges only; otherwise retain a review item.
culture_alias_basis: Explicit identity aliases or regional branches merged at installed V3 granularity; checked source keys, source language/groups and target definitions. Does not infer resident religion or citizenship.

culture_rules.reason: Merge reviewed regional Chinese branches at V3 Han granularity; keep Hui and Kaifeng Jewish identities outside this rule. Source religion is preserved separately.
EU5 Min-speaking Chinese regional branches to installed V3 Min.
EU5 Hakka-speaking Chinese branches to installed V3 Hakka.
Use the source language field, not a substring in the culture key; Yue-Wu is not Yue.
Merge the four EU5 Japanese regional branches at V3 Japanese granularity.
Preserve the existing V3 Occitan grouping rather than folding it into French.
Merge Maya-group regional identities at V3 Mayan granularity.
Merge explicitly Quechuan-group branches at V3 Quechua granularity; do not include other Andean groups by geography.

bon.reason: Preserve Bon identity and source icon; reuse the V3 broad heritage corresponding to EU5's buddhist grouping, not the Gelugpa religion.

nestorianism.reason: Preserve the source Christian denomination separately from Orthodox and Oriental Orthodox.

waldensian.reason: Preserve source denomination rather than silently merging into Protestant.

sammitiya.reason: Preserve the source Buddhist school as a separate religion.

manichaeism.reason: No installed heritage directly represents the source group; preserve an isolated source-group heritage, pending discrimination balance review.

yazidism.reason: No installed heritage directly represents the source group; preserve an isolated source-group heritage, pending discrimination balance review.

zoroastrian.reason: No installed heritage directly represents the source group; preserve an isolated source-group heritage, pending discrimination balance review.

jain.reason: Preserve Jain identity. Approximate source zero-demand wine/liquor/fish/livestock/wild_game as V3 wine/liquor/fish/meat taboos; other source demand modifiers are not transferred.

religion_group_basis: Explicit EU5 folk/tonal groups use V3's broad animist category. Original religion keys remain in the ledger and crosswalk. No blanket fallback for unknown religions or other religious groups.
notes: Resident mappings supplement the pinned political profile without changing country primary cultures or state religions.
Nubian is not automatically mapped to Nuba; shared source language is insufficient evidence.
Coptic, Hui, Kaifeng Jewish and other unresolved identities stay in the review queue until an explicit identity or custom definition is supplied.
Configured custom religions resolve only after their definitions, icons, heritage references and localization are generated and checked. No state religion replacement.
Custom religious mechanics are not reproduced; isolated heritage families and Jain demand approximations require game/balance verification before deployment.
